### `lib/src/usage_record.dart`

- **variable** `const usageRecordVersion` — The version of the record this code reads and writes.
- **enum `UsageStatus`** — Where a call is (§6.7, *One call's records*).
  - values: `started`, `submitted`, `running`, `succeeded`, `failed`, `canceled`, `unknown`
- **enum `UsageBasis`** — Where a record's cost came from (§6.7, `basis`): a money object's own basis, or nothing known.
  - values: `estimate`, `price`, `provider`, `charged`, `pending`, `unknown`
  - `static UsageBasis of(Money money)` — The basis a cost of [money]'s kind has.
- **enum `UsageProblem`** — Why a line of a month file is skipped (§6.7, *Reading*).
  - values: `notRecord`, `badField`, `unknownVersion`
- **variable** `const computeSessionEntry` — The entry a compute session's records name (§6.7, §6.15): a server's time, which no catalogue entry prices.
- **variable** `const conversationEntry` — The entry a native conversation's records name (§6.7): the conversation model, which no catalogue entry prices.
- **variable** `const conversationCaptionsEntry` — The entry of a conversation's captions (§6.7): its input transcription, a chain beside the conversation's.
- **variable** `const unknownUsageEntry` — The entry of a use that asked no model (§6.7): a plug-in's check, an action or a request of its own, which the record's `purpose.plugin` names instead.
- **variable** `const chargedFailureMark` — What marks a render's failure code where a paid service took one of its requests, so that it may have been charged whatever it came to (§6.7): its job keeps `charged.<code>`, and its tile says so beside the code.
- **function** `String chargedFailure(String code)` — [code] as a render's failure keeps it where a paid service took one of its requests ([chargedFailureMark]).
- **function** `(String, bool) unmarkedFailure(String code)` — A render's failure [code] as it was, and whether it is marked as possibly charged ([chargedFailure]).
- **class `UsageUnits`** — The units a record can hold (§6.7, `units`).
  - `static const counts` — Units counted, written as JSON integers.
  - `static const measures` — Units measured, written as decimal strings with at most [measureDigits] fractional digits.
  - `static const measureDigits` — How many fractional digits a measure may have.
  - `static const ofPlugin` — The units as the plug-in API's `Usage` names them, each with the record's name for it.
  - `static String? invalid(Map<String, ExactDecimal> units)` — The first unit in [units] a record cannot hold, or null.
- **class `UsageOperation`** — One operation a call made on FilmOpen credit, by the id both the app and the portal hold (§6.6, §6.7).
  - `const UsageOperation(this.id, {this.chargedCents, this.receipt, this.request})`
  - `final String id` — The operation's UUID, shared with the portal.
  - `final int? chargedCents` — What the portal's settled receipt charged, in cents; null while it has not settled.
  - `final String? receipt` — The portal's id for the settled receipt — its settlement row — where it gave one.
  - `final String? request` — The provider's own id for the request the operation carried, where its answer gave one.
  - `bool get settled` — Whether the portal's receipt has settled.
  - `Map<String, Object> toJson()` — The operation as a record's `operations` hold it: `status` `settled` with its `charged_cents`, else `pending`.
  - `static UsageOperation? fromJson(Object? json)` — An operation as a record holds it, or null for one that is not.
- **class `UsagePurpose`** — What a call was for (§6.7, `purpose`).
  - `const UsagePurpose({this.project, this.target, this.field, this.plugin})`
  - `final String? project`
  - `final String? target`
  - `final String? field`
  - `final String? plugin` — For a plug-in's call: `<plug-in stem>/<hook>`.
  - `Map<String, String> toJson()`
  - `static UsagePurpose? fromJson(Object? json)` — A purpose as a record holds it, or null for one that is not an object of strings.
- **class `UsageLine`** — One line of a month file, read (§6.7, *Reading*).
  - `const UsageLine()`
- **class `UsageRecordLine`** — A line that holds a record.
  - `const UsageRecordLine(this.record)`
  - `final UsageRecord record`
- **class `SkippedUsageLine`** — A line skipped, and why.
  - `const SkippedUsageLine(this.problem, {this.field, this.chain})`
  - `final UsageProblem problem`
  - `final String? field` — For [UsageProblem.badField], the field at fault.
  - `final String? chain` — For [UsageProblem.unknownVersion], the chain to skip whole: the record's `ref`, else its `id`.
- **class `UsageRecord`** — One usage record (§6.7, *A record*).
  - `UsageRecord({ required String id, required DateTime at, required UsageStatus status, String? ref, required String device, String? user, required St…` — A record.
  - `final String id` — A random UUID, version 4, in lower case ([newUsageId]).
  - `final DateTime at` — When this record was written: UTC, to the millisecond.
  - `final UsageStatus status`
  - `final String? ref` — The id of the chain's first record; null on the first record itself.
  - `final String device` — The id in the usage folder's `device.json`.
  - `final String? user` — The filmopen.ai user id, when signed in.
  - `final String app` — The version of the app that wrote this record.
  - `final String platform` — The catalogue's platform id.
  - `final String route` — `direct` on a copied key, `filmopen.ai` on credit, or token-only `plan` and `local`.
  - `final String entry` — The catalogue entry's id.
  - `final String? variant`
  - `final String kind` — The entry's kind.
  - `final String modelId` — The platform's name for the model.
  - `final UsagePurpose? purpose`
  - `final String? request` — The platform's request, job or session id.
  - `final String? key` — The copied key’s last four characters, or the slot/program/server setting on `plan` or `local`.
  - `final String? label` — The plan’s account or platform label, or the local platform’s name.
  - `final Map<String, ExactDecimal> units`
  - `final Money? estimate` — The cost expected before the call, on `started`; null where nothing prices the call as asked.
  - `final Money? cost` — What the call has cost so far, or in all.
  - `final UsageBasis? basis` — Where [cost] came from; [UsageBasis.unknown] where the call cost something nobody says, with no cost.
  - `final String? error` — A short code of the app's own, never a platform's message.
  - `final List<UsageOperation> operations` — The operations on FilmOpen credit the call's end accounts for, each with its settled charge, in the order they ended (§6.6); empty on a person's own key.
  - `static UsageLine parse(String line)` — Reads one line of a month file (§6.7, *Reading*): a record, or why the line is skipped.
  - `UsageRecord next({ required String id, required DateTime at, required UsageStatus status, required String app, String? error, String? request, Stri…` — The chain's next record (§6.7, *Later records*).
  - `Map<String, Object> toJson()` — The record as its line holds it, in version 2's order of fields.
  - `String toLine()` — The record's line, without its line feed.
- **function** `DateTime usageRecordTime(DateTime now, {DateTime? latest})` — When the chain's next record is written (§6.7, *Later records*).
- **function** `String newUsageId([Random? random])` — A new record id (§6.7): a random UUID, version 4, in lower case.
- **function** `String usageMonth(DateTime at)` — The month file a record goes to, by its own `at` in UTC (§6.7, *Files*): `2026-09`.

### `lib/src/usage_totals.dart`

- **enum `UsageBucket`** — Where a chain's money goes in the totals (§6.7, *Totals*).
  - values: `spent`, `pending`, `possiblyCharged`
- **class `UsageChain`** — One call's records (§6.7, *Which record counts*): a first record and every record whose `ref` names it.
  - `final String id` — The chain's first record's id, which every later record names in `ref`.
  - `final List<UsageRecord> records` — The chain's records in the order that decides which counts: by `at`, then by `id`.
  - `static List<UsageChain> of(Iterable<UsageRecord> records, {Set<String> skipped = const {}})` — The chains of [records], leaving out every chain [skipped] names.
  - `UsageRecord get counted` — The record that counts: the latest `at`, and on a tie the greater `id`.
  - `UsageRecord? get first` — The chain's first record, while the log still holds it.
  - `DateTime get countedAt` — When the chain counts: its first record's `at`, or its earliest record's when the first is missing.
  - `bool get costUnknown` — Whether the call ran up a cost nobody knows (§6.7, `basis` `unknown`), or has not ended and started with no estimate, nothing pricing it: counted apart, as a call, and never as money or as free.
- **class `UsageTotal`** — A line of the totals: one month, one platform and one currency.
  - `const UsageTotal({ required this.month, required this.platform, required this.currency, required this.spent, required this.pending, required this.p…`
  - `final String month` — The month, as its file is named: `2026-09`.
  - `final String platform`
  - `final String currency`
  - `final ExactDecimal spent` — Spent.
  - `final ExactDecimal pending` — Estimates pending, or possibly charged.
  - `final ExactDecimal possiblyCharged` — Estimates possibly charged, for calls the platform says do not exist.
  - `final int costUnknown` — How many calls cost something nobody knows ([UsageChain.costUnknown]), on the month's line for the platform: the one in their estimate's currency where there is one.
- **function** `List<UsageTotal> usageTotals(Iterable<UsageChain> chains)` — The totals of [chains] by month, platform and currency, newest month first.

### `lib/src/visual_style.dart`

- **variable** `const visualStyleKey` — The key of a project's or a folder's profile.
- **variable** `const visualStyleLeaves` — The leaves of a visual treatment (A.11), by dotted path under [visualStyleKey], with the tokens of each that is a vocabulary's; a leaf with none is a text, but `palette`, a list of colours.
- **variable** `const treatmentPromptLeaves` — The treatment's primary leaves (A.11), in the order a render's prompt takes them, each with the words that name it there — English, whatever the app's language, since the prompt is the model's (§8.7).
- **variable** `const styleSharedLeaves` — The leaves a Style (A.7) shares with a treatment, which a scene's Style brings to what applies to it (§8.7).
- **variable** `const paletteMost` — The most colours a palette holds (A.11).
- **variable** `final paletteColour` — A colour of a palette: `#rrggbb`.
- **function** `bool isPalette(List<Object?> colours)` — Whether [colours] make a palette (A.11): at most [paletteMost], each a text `#rrggbb` once trimmed.
- **function** `Map<String, Object> styleLeavesOf(Object? profile)` — The leaves [profile] holds that a reader takes (A.11), by dotted path: absent ones — a null, an empty text or an empty list (§13.3) — and a value of another shape left out; a palette taken whole, lowercased, or not at…
- **class `ComposedTreatment`** — A treatment composed for an entity (§8.7): each leaf that applies with the stem of the document it came from.
  - `const ComposedTreatment(this.leaves, this.sources, {this.ambiguous = false})` — A composition of [leaves], each from [sources]; [ambiguous] where the entity's place in the script is.
  - `final Map<String, Object> leaves` — The leaves that apply, by dotted path.
  - `final Map<String, String> sources` — The stem of the document each leaf came from, by its dotted path.
  - `final bool ambiguous` — Whether the entity's place in the script is ambiguous — listed twice, or under a folder listed twice or under itself — so that no folder's profile applied (§8.7).
  - `bool get isEmpty` — Whether nothing applies.
  - `Map<String, Object?> get profile` — The leaves as a `visual_style` object, objects nested by their paths.
- **function** `ComposedTreatment treatmentFor(FilmProject project, Entity entity, { Author? viewer, ScriptOutline? outline, bool withOwn = true, })` — What applies to [entity] (§8.7), as [viewer] reads the film: the project's profile, each folder's that holds it from the outermost in, its own where it is a folder ([withOwn]), then the Style a scene names — leaf by l…
- **function** `({List<Entity> folders, bool ambiguous}) scriptPlaceOf(ScriptOutline outline, EntityType type, String tag)` — Where [type] [tag] stands in the script: the folders that hold it, outermost first, and whether its place is ambiguous — listed more than once, or beneath a folder listed more than once or under itself.
- **function** `String composePrompt(String own, String? treatment, {Map<String, Object> leaves = const {}})` — The prompt a render is asked with (§8.7): [own], the entity's, first; then each primary leaf of [leaves] that holds words, as `Camera: …`, in [treatmentPromptLeaves]' order; then [treatment]'s words — each part trimme…
- **function** `AnalysisChanges styleChanges(Map<String, Object?> fields)` — A picture's described treatment as checked leaves under [visualStyleKey].

### `lib/src/vocabulary.dart`

- **variable** `const List<String> locationKinds` — A location's `kind` (§9.3, A.3).
- **variable** `const List<String> folderKinds` — A folder's `kind` (§10.1, A.5): a word for people, plug-ins and an export, and never a rule.
- **variable** `const List<String> characterGenders` — A character's `appearance.gender` (A.1): what the app writes; a file's other word is read as it is.
- **variable** `const List<String> voicePitches` — A character's `voice.pitch` (A.1).
- **variable** `const List<String> voicePaces` — A character's `voice.pace` (A.1).
- **variable** `const List<String> timesOfDay` — A location's default `time_of_day` (A.3), the scene's `time` vocabulary (A.5).

### `lib/src/voice_samples.dart`

- **variable** `const String voiceSamplesGroup` — The group a character's voice samples are in (§9.0).
- **function** `bool isVoiceId(Object? value)` — Whether [value] is an id a platform gives a voice or a preview of one: 1 to 128 letters, digits, `_` and `-`.
- **function** `bool isVoicePlatform(Object? value)` — Whether [value] names a platform as the catalogue does: `elevenlabs`.
- **class `VoiceBinding`** — A voice sample's provenance (§9.1): the platform it came from, the voice it was kept as, the preview it was.
  - `VoiceBinding({required this.provider, this.voiceId, this.generatedVoiceId})` — A binding; each id, where given, of [isVoiceId]'s grammar.
  - `final String provider` — The platform tag the sample came from: `elevenlabs`.
  - `final String? voiceId` — The persistent voice id the sample was kept as, which speech takes.
  - `final String? generatedVoiceId` — The id of the temporary preview the sample was.
  - `static VoiceBinding? fromJson(Object? json)` — The binding [json] is, or null where it is not one: an object whose `provider` names a platform and whose ids are of the grammar, none required.
  - `Map<String, Object?> toJson()` — The binding as an entry writes it.
  - `VoiceBinding keptAs(String id)` — This binding kept as [id]: the preview it was, now a voice of its platform.
- **function** `VoiceBinding? voiceBindingOf(MediaEntry entry)` — The binding [entry] carries (§9.1), or null where it carries none it can read.
- **function** `String? activeVoiceIdFor(Map<String, dynamic> json, String platform)` — The voice [json]'s character speaks with on [platform] (§9.1): `voice.provider_bindings`' id for it, or null.
- **function** `MediaEntry? activeVoiceSample(Map<String, dynamic> json)` — The live voice sample `voice.active_reference` names (§9.1), archived or not; null where it names none, which a reader ignores, never taking another sample in its place.
- **function** `List<MediaEntry> voicePreviews(Map<String, dynamic> json)` — The voice samples of [json] that are previews not yet kept (§9.1): live, shown, their binding naming a preview and no voice, in the group's order.
- **function** `bool isPreviewOnly(Map<String, dynamic> json, String id)` — Whether [id] is only a preview's in [json]: a voice sample's binding names it as the preview it was and no sample was kept as it.
